output_list.code: function balanceOf(address _owner) public view returns (uint256 balance) {        return balances[_owner];    }
output_list.reason: The code is vulnerable because the function balances[_owner] is used as a reference to _owner's balances, however the modifier returns also a uint256 balance argument which will store the output of this function. If the _owner sends more assets than initially held by _owner before this function is called, then any function calling balanceOf() will result in wrong output.
